events.content: Gina: Hey Jon! Good to see you. What's up? Anything new?
events.speaker: Gina

events.content: Jon: Hey Gina! Good to see you too. Lost my job as a banker yesterday, so I'm gonna take a shot at starting my own business.
events.speaker: Jon

events.content: Gina: Sorry about your job Jon, but starting your own business sounds awesome! Unfortunately, I also lost my job at Door Dash this month. What business are you thinking of?
events.speaker: Gina

events.content: Jon: Sorry to hear that! I'm starting a dance studio 'cause I'm passionate about dancing and it'd be great to share it with others.
events.speaker: Jon

events.content: Gina: That's cool, Jon! What got you into this biz?
events.speaker: Gina

events.content: Jon: I've been into dancing since I was a kid and it's been my passion and escape. I wanna start a dance studio so I can teach others the joy that dancing brings me.
events.speaker: Jon

events.content: Gina: Wow Jon, same here! Dance is pretty much my go-to for stress relief. Got any fave styles?
events.speaker: Gina

events.content: Jon: Cool, Gina! I love all dances, but contemporary is my top pick. It's so expressive and powerful! What's your fave?
events.speaker: Jon

events.content: Gina: Yeah, me too! Contemporary dance is so expressive and graceful - it really speaks to me.
events.speaker: Gina

events.content: Jon: Wow, great idea! Let's go to a dance class, it'll be so much fun!
events.speaker: Jon

events.content: Gina: Yeah! Let's explore some new dance moves. We should plan a dance session soon!
events.speaker: Gina

events.content: Jon: Yeah definitely! Wanna see my moves next Fri? Can't wait!
events.speaker: Jon

events.content: Gina: Sounds great, Jon! Next Friday works. Let's boogie!
events.speaker: Gina

events.content: Jon: [Image: a photography of a man in a suit is performing a dance] Wow, I'm excited too! This is gonna be great!
events.speaker: Jon

events.content: Gina: Wow! What did you get?
events.speaker: Gina

events.content: Jon: Woah, that pic's from when my dance crew took home first in a local comp last year. It was amazing up on that stage! I'm super keen to spread that intensity with other peeps. Gina, you ever been in any dance comps or shows?
events.speaker: Jon

events.content: Gina: [Image: a photography of a couple of people standing next to each other] I used to compete in a few dance competitions and shows - my fav memory was when my team won first place at a regionals at age fifteen. It was an awesome feeling of accomplishment!
events.speaker: Gina

events.content: Jon: Wow! Winning first place is amazing! What dance were you doing?
events.speaker: Jon

events.content: Gina: [Image: a photo of a large open porch with a fireplace and a view of the water] Thanks! We just did a contemporary piece called "Finding Freedom." It was really emotional and powerful.
events.speaker: Gina

events.content: Jon: [Image: a photography of a room with a view of the ocean and a few yoga mats] Wow, that must've been great! Check my ideal dance studio by the water.
events.speaker: Jon

events.content: Gina: Cool setup! Man, you can't deny that view! Got time to rehearse with a biz and a new store?
events.speaker: Gina

events.content: Jon: Hopefully, we will find a place like this that will inspire us!
events.speaker: Jon

events.content: Gina: Wow, it looks great! What dances do you practice? Got any projects planned?
events.speaker: Gina

events.content: Jon: [Image: a photo of a group of dancers in white dresses on a stage] Thanks! I rehearsed with a small group of dancers after work. We do all kinds of dances, from contemporary to hip-hop. We've got some cool projects in the works. Finishing up choreography to perform at a nearby festival next month. Can't wait!
events.speaker: Jon

events.content: Gina: Wow, it looks awesome! Are they yours at the festival? They're so graceful!
events.speaker: Gina

events.content: Jon: Yeah, they're the ones performing at the festival! They've been practicing hard and will definitely impress with their grace and skill.
events.speaker: Jon

events.content: Gina: Wow, they look great! Can't wait to see them rock the festival. Gonna be awesome!
events.speaker: Gina

events.content: Jon: Yeah, awesome! Glad to be part of it.
events.speaker: Jon

events.content: Gina: [Image: a photo of a clothing store with a variety of clothes on display] Hey Jon! Long time no see! Things have been hectic lately. I just launched an ad campaign for my clothing store in hopes of growing the business. Starting my own store and taking risks is both scary and rewarding. I'm excited to see where it takes me!
events.speaker: Gina

events.content: Jon: Hey Gina! Whoa, your store looks great! All your hard work really paid off - congrats! Must be awesome to see your stuff on display.
events.speaker: Jon

events.content: Gina: Thanks a bunch! It's awesome seeing my vision happen. How's the dance studio going? Did you find the right spot?
events.speaker: Gina

events.content: Jon: [Image: a photo of a bathroom with a blue floor and a pink wall] Hey Gina! Thanks for asking. I'm on the hunt for the ideal spot for my dance studio and it's been quite a journey! I've been looking at different places and picturing how the space would look. I even found a place with great natural light! Oh, I've been to Paris yesterday! It was sooo cool.
events.speaker: Jon

events.content: Gina: Wow, nice spot! Where is it? Got any other features you want to think about before you decide? Paris?! That is really great Jon! Never had a chance to visit it. Been only to Rome once.
events.speaker: Gina

events.content: Jon: It's downtown which is awesome cuz it's easy to get to. Plus the natural light! Gotta check the size & floor quality too. We need a good dance floor with enough bounce for me & my students to dance safely.
events.speaker: Jon

events.content: Gina: Definitely! Dance floors help avoid injuries and make dancing more enjoyable. You thinking about it is great. Any particular type of flooring you like?
events.speaker: Gina

events.content: Jon: Yeah, good flooring's crucial. I'm after Marley flooring, which is what dance studios usually use. It's great 'cause it's grippy but still lets you move, plus it's tough and easy to keep clean.
events.speaker: Jon

events.content: Gina: Sounds great! Marley's perfect; it's got the right amount of grip and movement. Can't wait to see your dance studio done!
events.speaker: Gina

events.content: Jon: Yeah, can't wait to see it done! Looking for the right place and getting everything ready has been a mix of exciting and nerve-wracking, but I'm determined to make it work. It'll be worth it!
events.speaker: Jon

events.content: Gina: Believe in yourself, Jon! The process may be tough, but you got this. Push through and it'll be worth it. Don't forget to take breaks and dance it out when you need to destress!
events.speaker: Gina

events.content: Jon: Glad I have you in my corner! Gotta make time to dance and vent, that's for sure. We'll make it through this - hang in there!
events.speaker: Jon

events.content: Gina: Thanks, Jon! Appreciate your support!
events.speaker: Gina

events.content: Jon: Let's keep going and chase our dreams!
events.speaker: Jon

events.content: Gina: Yeah! We've done so much, and there's nothing but good stuff coming. Let's keep going after our goals and making them happen.
events.speaker: Gina

events.content: Jon: Success is almost here. We got this!
events.speaker: Jon

events.content: Jon: Hey Gina, hope you're doing ok! Still following my passion for dance. It's been bumpy, but I'm determined to make it work. I'm still searching for a place to open my dance studio.
events.speaker: Jon

events.content: Gina: [Image: a photography of a shopping mall with a glass entrance and a sign] Hi Jon! So happy you're pushing forward with dancing! Inspiring 💪 I emailed some wholesalers and one replied and said yes today! I'm over the moon because now I can expand my clothing store and get closer to my customers. Check it out - here's a pic!
events.speaker: Gina

events.content: Jon: [Image: a photo of a room with a mirror and a wooden floor] Wow, Gina! You found the perfect spot for your store. Way to go, hard work's paying off!
events.speaker: Jon

events.content: Gina: [Image: a photography of a clothing store with a lot of clothes on display] Thanks! Glad you like it. Yeah, it's a great spot. Here's a peek at the space I designed. Cozy and inviting - perfect for customers to check out all the trendy pieces.
events.speaker: Gina

events.content: Jon: Wow, it looks great! Must've taken you ages to design it. What made you pick out the furniture and decor?
events.speaker: Jon

events.content: Gina: Thanks! It took a bit of time but I wanted to make the place look like my own style and make my customers feel cozy. I chose furniture that looks great and is comfy too. The chandelier adds a nice glam feel while matching the style of the store.
events.speaker: Gina

events.content: Jon: Your store looks great - your customers will be so comfy.
events.speaker: Jon

events.content: Gina: Thanks! Making my spot comfortable and inviting for my customers is key. I want 'em to feel like they're in a cool oasis. Just creating an experience that'll make 'em wanna come back.
events.speaker: Gina

events.content: Jon: That's a great goal! Creating a special experience for customers is the key to making them feel welcome and coming back. I think you can create that space you're imagining.
events.speaker: Jon

events.content: Gina: Thanks. Your support means a lot. I'm sure with my hard work and effort, I can make a special shopping experience for my customers. It's tough but I'm up for the challenge!
events.speaker: Gina

events.content: Jon: I'm always here to support you! Go create something awesome with your store. Keep it up!
events.speaker: Jon

events.content: Gina: Thanks, Jon! I'll try my best. You're gonna do great with your dance studio, just keep going and stay positive! We'll get through this!
events.speaker: Gina

events.content: Jon: Thanks! Your words mean a lot. I'm staying positive and pushing forward. We've put our hearts into our dreams and I'm sure we'll make it.
events.speaker: Jon

events.content: Gina: Sure thing, Jon! Stay motivated and keep going. Hard work pays off eventually. We can do this!
events.speaker: Gina

events.content: Jon: Hey Gina! What's up? How's the store going? I gotta tell you about this thing with my biz.
events.speaker: Jon

events.content: Gina: Hey Jon! The store's doing great! It's a wild ride. How's the biz?
events.speaker: Gina

events.content: Jon: Hey Gina! I'm putting in a lot of work on my business even with the obstacles. I'm gonna make it happen!
events.speaker: Jon

events.content: Gina: Wow! You've got drive! Keep it up and you'll definitely make a splash.
events.speaker: Gina

events.content: Jon: Thanks Gina! Your help really means a lot. Sometimes it's hard when things don't go my way, but I'm sure if I keep pushing, I'll reach my dreams!
events.speaker: Jon

events.content: Gina: Understand where you're at, Jon. Setbacks are just opportunities for comebacks. You got the skills, passion, and drive. Plus my full support. Don't give up, buddy!
events.speaker: Gina

events.content: Jon: Thanks! Setbacks can be tough, but with your support, I can handle anything. Appreciate you having my back!
events.speaker: Jon

events.content: Gina: I'm here for you no matter what! Anything you want to say about your biz?
events.speaker: Gina

events.content: Jon: Searching for a dance studio location has been tricky, but I'm determined to find the right spot - when I do, I'm sure the rest will follow!
events.speaker: Jon

events.content: Gina: Searching for the perfect dance studio's a tough job, Jon. Hang in there and you'll find it soon!
events.speaker: Gina

events.content: Jon: [Image: a photo of a woman in a gray dress doing a trick] Thanks! Appreciate your encouragement - it means a lot! I'm working on my business and some new dance routines - rehearsing hard for an upcoming show. I'm passionate about dancing and it brings me so much joy and fulfillment.
events.speaker: Jon

events.content: Gina: Wow, Jon! You're so talented! What show ya got planned?
events.speaker: Gina

events.content: Jon: I'm getting ready for a dance comp near me next month. It's a great chance for me to show my skillz and, hopefully, get some props from the dance fam. Super stoked!
events.speaker: Jon

events.content: Gina: Wow Jon, you're gonna kill it in that competition. Your hard work and talent will pay off! Good luck.
events.speaker: Gina

events.content: Jon: Thanks! Your help means a lot. I'll do my best to make you proud!
events.speaker: Jon

events.content: Gina: No doubt, Jon you've got this. Your passion and commitment are awesome! Keep it up!
events.speaker: Gina

events.content: Jon: Thanks! I'm going for my dreams!
events.speaker: Jon

events.content: Gina: Absolutely Jon. I'm always here to cheer you on. Make your dreams happen - keep going and believe in yourself. You got this!
events.speaker: Gina

events.content: Jon: Thanks, Gina! Your kind words mean a lot. I won't give up!
events.speaker: Jon

events.content: Gina: [Image: a photo of a group of women posing with a giant balloon] Hey Jon! Great hearing from you again. How have you been? BTW, I found a cool new fashion piece for my store. Can't wait to share with my customers.
events.speaker: Gina

events.content: Jon: [Image: a photo of a group of young girls in a dance studio] Hey Gina! Congrats on the new fashion piece! Looks like your store is growing. Remenber the festival I told you about? Had that performance and it was awesome - so many people there complementing my dance moves. Dancing brings me joy and it was nice to be reminded why I'm passionate about it.
events.speaker: Jon

events.content: Gina: Wow! That looks great. You look badass on stage. BTW, what's your favorite part of running your own studio?
events.speaker: Gina

events.content: Jon: Thanks, Gina! I love running my own studio. It's great having the freedom to create a space and help dancers of all ages and levels express themselves. I'm super thrilled about dancing each day and seeing my students progress. It's so fulfilling.
events.speaker: Jon

events.content: Gina: [Image: a photo of a rack of clothes with a coat and a dress] That's awesome! I'm sure you feel great knowing your students are doing so well with dance. It's amazing what it can do for people! Oh, and btw - I've been working hard on my online store and just teamed up with a local artist for some cool designs. Check 'em out!
events.speaker: Gina

events.content: Jon: It looks awesome. Your commitment and creativity in your business really stands out. How'd you come up with these cool designs?
events.speaker: Jon

events.content: Gina: Thanks Jon! I got the idea from a fashion mag and saw there wasn't much around like it. So I worked with the artist to make it happen - it's all about being ahead of the game and giving my customers something different.
events.speaker: Gina

events.content: Jon: Nice one, Gina! You never shy away from a challenge and always try something new. I'm impressed by your willingness to take risks - it's really inspiring.
events.speaker: Jon

events.content: Gina: Thanks! Taking risks is scary but it's the only way to grow, right? Just part of the journey to success.
events.speaker: Gina

events.content: Jon: Yeah, I totally agree - taking risks is key for success. It's made me grow, and even got me out of my secure 9-5 as a banker. Now, I'm aiming to turn my dancing passion into a business. I'm determined to make it work, I just know it! That being said, I definitely don't underestimate the difficulties - it ain't been a walk in the park, that's for sure.
events.speaker: Jon

events.content: Gina: It's tough starting a biz, but don't let it get you down. You can make your studio work, I'm sure. And remember, I'm always here for you.
events.speaker: Gina

events.content: Jon: [Image: a photography of a cartoon character with a quote about fear] Thanks, Gina. Your help means a lot. I'll keep plugging away and stay optimistic.
events.speaker: Jon

events.content: Gina: [Image: a photo of a woman standing on a balcony with a blue dress] This quote kept me positive through tough times. We all need a push sometimes, right? Even made a tattoo to remind myself about it.
events.speaker: Gina

events.content: Jon: Love the tattoo, did you just get it?
events.speaker: Jon

events.content: Gina: Thanks! Got the tattoo a few years ago, it stands for freedom - dancing without worrying what people think. A reminder to follow my passions and express myself.
events.speaker: Gina

events.content: Jon: [Image: a photo of a woman in a tutu posing for a picture] Nice reminder, Gina! It's so important to have freedom and express ourselves without worry. Dance gives me an escape to be myself.
events.speaker: Jon

events.content: Gina: Totally agree, Jon. Dancing lets us be ourselves and ain't nothing like the feeling it gives us. You're so dedicated to your studio, it's inspiring. Chase those dreams, buddy!
events.speaker: Gina

events.content: Jon: [Image: a photo of a trophy with a glass globe on top] Thanks, Gina! Your support means so much. I'm gonna keep chasing after those dreams. Dance is my passion, and I'm gonna keep working hard to make it a success!
events.speaker: Jon

events.content: Gina: This is the right attitude! How have you been juggling dance and business goals?
events.speaker: Gina

events.content: Jon: Thanks! Juggling both my passions can be tricky, but so rewarding. Dancing and running my biz need hard work, plus they give me energy for each other. My dance moves get me pumped to tackle my business goals, and successes there boost my drive to keep dreaming on the dance floor. It's a balancing act, but fun.
events.speaker: Jon

events.content: Gina: Wow, Jon! You're amazing at juggling both your passions. Finding that happy medium is key - keep going and don't stop dreaming, buddy!
events.speaker: Gina

events.content: Jon: Thanks, Gina! Your pep-talk really meant a lot. I'm not gonna give up on my dreams - my dance studio and biz ventures need the hard work I'm putting in. Love having you in my corner, thanks for always being there!
events.speaker: Jon

events.content: Gina: Yeah Jon, I'm here for you! Chasing our dreams and helping each other out. Let's keep movin' forward!
events.speaker: Gina
